mechanisms.name: precipitation strengthening
mechanisms.material_state: annealed at 900 °C for 1 h and further annealed at 700 °C for 1 h

evidence.quote: the high density precipitates inside the grains effectively compensate for the yield strength loss caused by the decrease in dislocation density
the strength increase is not obvious due to the absence of secondary phase precipitation and weak grain refinement strengthening

mechanisms.name: Orowan bypassing
mechanisms.material_state: annealed at 900 °C for 1 h and further annealed at 700 °C for 1 h

evidence.quote: the precipitate pins the dislocation (red arrow) and leaves dislocation loops (yellow arrow) which confirms that dislocations proliferate through the mechanism of Orowan bypassing the particles

mechanisms.name: deformation twinning
mechanisms.material_state: annealed at 900 °C for 1 h and further annealed at 700 °C for 1 h

evidence.quote: single direction deformation twins were generated in addition to dislocation slip ( Fig. 8 (a) and b). When the strain was large, secondary twins were triggered and intersected with the primary twins, further dividing the grains.

mechanisms.name: dislocation slip
mechanisms.material_state: annealed at 900 °C for 1 h and further annealed at 700 °C for 1 h

evidence.quote: the dislocation slip and interacting with high density nanoscale precipitates, the initiation of primary and secondary deformation twinning which further segmenting the grains are the main reasons for such high properties
